purpose: E5: minimal correction of null-threshold transfer, no network retraining
motivation: Post-E4 amendment: original H=.5 thresholds transfer poorly to persistent fGn. E4 remains an adverse result, not a tuning set.

calibration.rule: For each H, sort null scores and use one-based rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)). Take the maximum of these group quantiles. Reject strictly above the frozen threshold. One threshold per length/method/checkpoint/score, not conditioned on test H.

predeclared_acceptance.interpolated_H_rule: H=.3/.7 are held-out interpolation checks; flag mean FPR above .10. They do not establish a continuous-H guarantee.
predeclared_acceptance.interpretation: Practical predeclared checks, not equivalence tests or guarantees of future FPR. Report all failures and confidence intervals without selecting a replacement rule on this test.

invariants: Never use calibration MRW positives; calibrate using null fGn only.
Complete and hash calibration before generating the new test set.
No use of E4 test outcomes for numerical threshold selection.
Original R1 thresholds evaluated unchanged on the same new test set for paired comparisons.
Keep signed-coordinate negative bias and stress-process acceptance findings; thresholding cannot repair them.
No H!=.5 MRW reference claims; no universal mechanism-discrimination claim.
No overwrite of previous results or checkpoints.
